title: fix(fields): the rich-text editor draws no hint lines on any surface (objectui#12110)
body:
Fixes #12110
Clause-②: no

Item 7's second half of objectui#12110, as ruled **B** in comment `6115662567`: "the rich-text widget's editable header drops both hint lines on every surface". Items 1 to 6 and item 7's heading landed earlier in PR objectui#12151 (`main` `5330038`); this PR does not reopen them, and it is the last open part of the card.

## What changed

- **`RichTextField`** (`packages/fields/src/widgets/RichTextField.tsx`). The module-local `RichTextEditorSurface` no longer draws its header row ("Format: markdown" / "Format: html" and "Rich text editor (basic)"). Its `formatLabel` and `hint` props are gone, and so is their resolution (the two `t()` calls and the `syntax` / `format` locals). Both renderings, inline and the fullscreen dialog, use this one surface, so the lines are gone from both. No empty spans are left; the wrapper drops its `space-y-2`, which now had nothing to space. The field type is resolved inside the readonly branch, its only reader now. The field's own `placeholder` (resolved once, handed to both renderings) and the host's help text are unchanged.
- **`richTextSyntax`** (`packages/fields/src/widgets/richTextDisplay.tsx`) is deleted with its doc comment. Its only reader was the removed header; it was never re-exported from the package entry (the barrel names `MarkdownCellRenderer`, `HtmlCellRenderer`, `RICH_TEXT_FIELD_TYPES` and `RichTextFieldType` from this module, nothing else), and `@object-ui/fields` exports only `.` and `./style.css`.
- **Docs** (`content/docs/fields/rich-text.mdx`). One sentence said the editing surface is "a plain textarea with a format indicator". It now says there is no header row, and that guidance comes from the field's own `placeholder` and help text.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/12110-richtext-editor-hints.md`: `@object-ui/fields` `patch`.

No export, prop, type member or locale key changes. The ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs are untouched: `fields.richText.format` and `fields.richText.basicEditorHint` stay, as the ruling says ("No contract change, no new export, no locale key"); see Acceptance notes.

## The pin

`apps/console/src/components/FormPage.richTextHints-12110.test.tsx` renders the same three rich-text fields (`markdown`, `html`, `richtext`) through both routes `FormPage` serves: the anonymous `/f/:slug` page and the internal `/forms/:name` page. On each route:

- `NO_HINT_LINE`: neither line is drawn anywhere on the page.
- `AUTHORED_GUIDANCE_STAYS`: the authored `placeholder` reaches the editor and the authored help text renders under the row. This is the control for "the field's own help text and placeholder stay".

Both legs first wait for every editor by its label and require exactly one textarea per row (a `HARNESS DEAD 12110` error otherwise), so an absence is read off rendered editors.

Three existing `packages/fields` tests asserted the label as present; each now asserts it absent and stays load-bearing:

- `RichTextField.fullscreenDisabled.test.tsx`, "keeps the dialog holding the REAL editor, disabled and not" (three types). The label was the case's "same surface in both positions" vehicle. That vehicle moved to an authored `placeholder` counted twice, the vehicle `RichTextField.mobileFullscreen.test.tsx` already used. The header prose that named `formatLabel` / `hint` is corrected.
- `RichTextField.mobileFullscreen.test.tsx`, "puts the REAL editor in the dialog, not a degraded copy of it".
- `readonly-richtext-display-5498.test.tsx`, the discriminator block (three types). It now reads the textarea first, then asserts no format label and no basic-editor line on the editable item.

## Premise checks (the dispatch's hypotheses, measured on `d2500d8`)

- **H1 held.** The two lines were drawn only by the surface's header row; inline and dialog both took `formatLabel` / `hint` from one resolution.
- **H2 held.** `git grep` finds no other reader of the two keys outside the ten packs. After this change `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` lists both as `[confirmed]` under `fields.richText (2 confirmed, 0 needs-review)`. That gate is report-only (exit 0).
- **H3 extended.** A third test asserted the label: `RichTextField.mobileFullscreen.test.tsx` (`getAllByText('Format: html')`). No hit in `apps/` or `e2e/`. Its edit is the same flip.
- **H4 corrected.** The two stale comments in `richTextDisplay.tsx` are the doc comment of `richTextSyntax`, whose only call site was the removed header. The function had no reader left, so it went with the comments instead of being re-commented as an orphan.
- **H5: cheap, so the pin covers both pages.** The public and internal `FormPage` harnesses already exist (fetch stubs, `MemoryRouter`). The editor is behind `React.lazy`, but `FormPage` imports the `@object-ui/fields` barrel, which re-exports `./widgets/RichTextField.js` statically, so the lazy factory resolves from the module cache.

## Reverse verification (one run, not committed)

With the fix committed (`f507c0f`), `RichTextField.tsx` and `richTextDisplay.tsx` were overwritten with their `d2500d8` blobs under a `trap` restore. On-disk hashes matched the base blobs (`8a545a9…`, `d8c1de5…`). `It draws no header row.` went from 1 to 0 and `export function richTextSyntax` from 0 to 1. The four touched files were then run:

- 9 failed, 33 passed.
- Red: `NO_HINT_LINE` on the public and the internal route (`expected 'Support requestRequestDetailsFormat: …' not to contain 'Format: markdown'`), the three 5498 discriminator cases, the three fullscreenDisabled cases (`expected [ SPAN, SPAN ] to have a length of +0 but got 2`) and the mobileFullscreen case.
- Green: both `AUTHORED_GUIDANCE_STAYS` controls.

Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`. On-disk hashes equal the HEAD blobs (`392fb22…`, `422a154…`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The tests resolve `@object-ui/fields` to `packages/fields/src` through the vitest and console aliases, so no dist rebuild was involved.

## Verification at `f507c0f`

- Build: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...' --concurrency=2` (a superset of the `@object-ui/fields^...` closure, needed for the console type-check): 34/34 successful, 17 cached. The run was at `529cb27`; the later commit touches test files only.
- `type-check` (script name echoed: `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) for `@object-ui/fields`: green at `f507c0f`. For `@object-ui/console` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force`; its `tsconfig.json` includes `src` with no test exclude): green at `529cb27`, the head that added the pin.
- vitest, 18 files, 571 passed: the four touched files; `richtext-host-plumbing-e2e`, `readonly-host-plumbing-e2e`, `richtext-cell-renderer-5452`, `widget-aria-invalid-e2e`, `widget-aria-invalid-registry-e2e`, `widget-dom-leak-e2e`, `RichTextField.rows`, `richtext-field-metadata-7083`; the components `fullscreen-editor-dialog-aria` and `form-fullscreen-flag-single-spelling`; plugin-detail `InlineFieldInput.markdownEditor-11541`; app-shell `richtextSurfaceParity`; console `FormPage.publicHeading`; and schema-catalog `form-field-channel-census-12130`.
- ESLint, narrowed to the 6 changed TS files (5 under `packages/fields`, 1 under `apps/console`, counted from `--format json`): 0 errors, and 13 warnings, all on lines this diff does not touch. Population: each package's `lint` is `eslint .`, resolved against the root flat config (neither package has its own). Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads other files, so this diff cannot change the verdict on an untouched file. The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Gates, each exit 0:
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (6 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset);
  - `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `pnpm check:control-bytes`;
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`);
  - `pnpm check:phantom-deps`, `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only);
  - `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 8 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface beyond the claim** (`6115774198`). Both items are forced by the removal:
  - deleting `richTextSyntax` is a code edit in `richTextDisplay.tsx`, where the claim had comment-only lines;
  - `content/docs/fields/rich-text.mdx`, one sentence the change made false.
- **Dead catalogue keys.** `fields.richText.format` and `fields.richText.basicEditorHint` have no reader after this change. They are kept on purpose: deleting them would narrow the published `TranslationKeys`, which the ruling excludes. Carrier: whoever next edits the `@object-ui/i18n` packs. Not filed.
- **Docs.** The same `rich-text.mdx` page has a "Cell Renderer" section saying grids show rich text as plain text, while its "Features" list (and the code) render it formatted. That contradiction predates this PR, and this PR does not change it. Carrier: none. Not filed.
- **CI.** `Spec Main Shape Gate` is red on every objectui PR today, at the upstream-driven `flow-node-refs.ts` change that objectui#12170 is repairing. This PR does not touch that file.
